pages.title: Free Cell Solitaire
pages.creator: Tweensoft
pages.description: Clear a deal by building four suit foundations in Free Cell Solitaire. Use the spare cells to uncover tableau cards and arrange the columns in descending, alternating colors. Move available cards onto the home piles from ace through king to complete the game.

pages.title: UFO IO Armada!
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Pilot a spacecraft through a dairy-themed conquest in UFO IO Armada! Control the UFO, manage resources, and work toward taking over planets across the galaxy. Dash with Z when faster movement is needed and use the equipment action to support the expedition.

pages.title: Zoo Restaurant
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Serve animal guests in Zoo Restaurant. Combine the game's merging activities with preparing desserts and completing customer requests, earning income for the growing business. Keep the food service moving while developing the restaurant into a larger operation.

pages.title: Word Solitaire
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Sort vocabulary into themed piles in Word Solitaire. Reveal category cards and drag the corresponding words onto them, grouping related cards to make clearing easier. Match every word to its category and use boosters when the remaining layout needs help.

pages.title: Sudoku Brain Blocks
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Fit shapes onto a nine-by-nine board in Sudoku Brain Blocks. Complete rows, columns, or three-by-three areas to remove occupied cells and increase the score. Plan the placement of each piece, since the attempt ends when no space remains for new blocks.

pages.title: Tiny Farm
pages.creator: Orenji Spark
pages.description: Develop an agricultural plot in Tiny Farm. Click crops to harvest them, collect animal products, and select the truck to sell the goods. Improve crops, unlock additional animals, and gather stars that open more farms to cultivate.

pages.title: Magic Christmas Tree Match-3
pages.creator: Broccoli Games
pages.description: Help decorate a festive town in Magic Christmas Tree Match-3. Arrange at least three matching pieces to clear them and complete stage tasks. Larger combinations create special pieces such as line-clearing rockets or spinners, providing more ways to reach the level's objective.

pages.title: Draw To Fly
pages.creator: Eyestorm Pte. LTD.
pages.description: Sketch a safe route through puzzles in Draw To Fly. Draw lines that guide the character toward the finish, accounting for traps and other barriers around the scene. Adapt each new path to the level's arrangement so the traveler can continue past the obstacles.

pages.title: Princess Dress Up Run
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Collect an outfit during a fantasy-course run in Princess Dress Up Run. Choose dresses, shoes, and accessories that suit the current goal while navigating the track. Keep the character away from flames, broken platforms, and other traps before completing the princess look.

pages.title: Blob Hero
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Develop a survivor during waves of attackers in Blob Hero. Move the blob away from enemies and monsters while choosing skills and upgrades that support the next encounter. Keep improving the hero's abilities as the ongoing survival challenge brings more threats into the field.

pages.title: Wall Hop
pages.creator: TuuT
pages.description: Aim a rebounding shot toward its destination in Wall Hop. Use the walls to redirect the trajectory and line up a bounce into the hole. Judge the angle before committing the attempt, then adjust your approach to the next puzzle layout.

pages.title: Moto Attack
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Drive an armed vehicle into road battles in Moto Attack. Race through the course while fighting and shooting the enemies along the route. Keep advancing through the hostile groups, using the vehicle's attacks to clear another stretch of the combat drive.

pages.title: Craft Man Vs Giant TNT
pages.creator: Online Games
pages.description: Build defenses against destructive threats in Craft Man Vs Giant TNT. Play as a craftsman, set up fortifications, and use weapons to repel giants in the block-style world. Choose between Destroy TNT and City TNT for different versions of the confrontation.

pages.title: Octopus Invasion
pages.creator: Supercode Games
pages.description: Grow an underwater predator in Octopus Invasion. Swipe to hunt smaller creatures, earn experience, and upgrade speed, tentacles, or carrying capacity. Meet the requirements for new forms and enter deeper ocean zones as the octopus becomes stronger.

pages.title: GT Micro Racers
pages.creator: Breymantech
pages.description: Race miniature sports cars over household objects in GT Micro Racers. Steer along backyard tracks formed from books, cans, and wooden ramps. Handle the sharp turns and scattered obstacles as the small vehicle competes across the oversized everyday scenery.

pages.title: Mushroom Fever Match 3
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Collect matching fungi in Mushroom Fever Match 3. Swap pieces to create rows or columns of at least three identical mushrooms, completing the task assigned to each board. Clear stages to open more of the forest-themed puzzle journey.

pages.title: Squid Escape But Blockworld
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Escape a pursuing monster through block-built terrain in Squid Escape But Blockworld. Keep running toward the purple portal, moving around the obstacles along the route. Collect money when the path permits it, but do not let the chase interrupt the journey to safety.

pages.title: Ice Skating Ballerina
pages.creator: Gamerina
pages.description: Prepare two contestants for a winter competition in Ice Skating Ballerina. Customize skates and choose clothing and accessories for Ellie and Ben. Compare the colorful performance outfits and finish both characters' looks before their appearance on the ice.

pages.title: Cube Combo
pages.creator: Puppy Yolk Studio
pages.description: Reduce a numbered arrangement in Cube Combo. Drag equal-valued blocks together to merge them, working toward the required target or leaving only a single block. Consider how each combination changes the next available match before completing the level.

pages.title: Flick 'n Bounce
pages.creator: Ohayō
pages.description: Keep attackers at a distance in Flick 'n Bounce. Wait for enemies to enter a useful position, then flick them away with the mouse or a swipe. Use the available props to handle crowded moments and keep the approaching group from reaching the defender.

pages.title: Merge Blocks 2048 Style!
pages.creator: IT-Hype
pages.description: Build a higher-numbered pile in Merge Blocks 2048 Style! Drop cubes into the play area so equal values combine, earning points through successive merges. Creating the largest cube makes it disappear for a larger reward and frees space for further combinations.

pages.title: Princesses of Quadrobics
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Style two friends for a themed activity in Princesses of Quadrobics. Choose makeup, practical hairstyles, clothing, and accessories for Eliza and the Little Mermaid. Complete the coordinated looks and save the result as a PNG image if you want a copy.

pages.title: Northern Lights - the secret of the forest
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Explore a storybook forest through matching in Northern Lights - the secret of the forest. Combine identical objects, earn emeralds, and unlock new territories. Meet familiar fairy-tale characters while progressing through the Scientist Cat's collection of hidden items and matching challenges.

pages.title: Line on Hole
pages.creator: TuuT
pages.description: Complete dot-based patterns in Line on Hole. Connect the points to solve each arrangement, moving from simple lines to more involved designs. Earn coins for completed levels, unlock different backgrounds, and use hints when the next connection is difficult to find.

pages.title: Live or Die
pages.creator: Artem Lanin
pages.description: Switch between living and ghostly movement in Live or Die. Collect a key and reach the room's exit while alive, moving and jumping around the platforms. Taking damage turns the character into a ghost that can fly through obstacles, changing the route available through the puzzle.

pages.title: Assassin Commando Car Driving
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Fight other vehicles in Assassin Commando Car Driving. Use a mechanical arm to punch alongside the car, crash into opponents, and fire when the machine-gun skill is ready. Improve the vehicle's equipment to support further battles along the vertical road.

pages.title: Grow Wars.io
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Slash through an arena contest in Grow Wars.io. Attack rivals, dash away from threats, and collect coins for new heroes or equipment. Play alone or share the keyboard with a second player, using the separate controls to develop each fighter's run.

pages.title: Sisyphus Simulator
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Push a heavy stone uphill in Sisyphus Simulator. Guide the rock carefully so it keeps gaining height instead of rolling back down. Reach the summit and collect the honor star to finish the challenge and record the achievement on the board.

pages.title: Stickman Brawler
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Fight through crowds with a customizable warrior in Stickman Brawler. Choose up to three abilities, including sweeping kicks, summoned golems, or a giant transformation. Gather town resources for power-ups and unlock achievements while continuing the battle against rival stick figures.

pages.title: Bhide Pickle Delivery
pages.creator: Neela Mediatech Private Limited
pages.description: Make food deliveries in Bhide Pickle Delivery. Guide Bhide left or right while landing at each customer's address, bringing Madhvi's pickle and papad orders to the correct location. Use a mouse drag or touch movement to line up the next delivery.

pages.title: Summer Festivals Fashion
pages.creator: Gamerina
pages.description: Style six friends for summer events in Summer Festivals Fashion. Choose outfits for three different parties, mixing clothing and accessories for each appearance. Complete the group's looks so the friends are ready to attend the festivals together.

pages.title: Unicorn Coloring Pages
pages.creator: mapacarta
pages.description: Paint fantasy scenes in Unicorn Coloring Pages. Pick a unicorn illustration and select shades from the color swatches to fill its different areas. Build your chosen palette across the character, rainbow, and landscape details before completing the picture.

pages.title: Maze of Death
pages.creator: Catom Games
pages.description: Find a route out of an infested dungeon in Maze of Death. Explore the maze in first person and use collected weapons against the zombie groups blocking the way. Check the map, switch firearms, and reach the exit as quickly as possible.

pages.title: Fill The Battery
pages.creator: BestGameSpot
pages.description: Redirect power toward rechargeable targets in Fill The Battery. Rotate mirrors and use energy teleports to connect each source with the batteries. Work out how the beam travels through the grid and align the pieces until the required batteries receive energy.

pages.title: Besties Makeover Salon
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Help friends recover their summer looks in Besties Makeover Salon. Work through facial-care steps to clean the characters' skin and address the blemishes shown in the game. Complete the makeover activities for each friend before finishing the salon session.

pages.title: Mr Noobs vs Stickman
pages.creator: TapTapking.com
pages.description: Lead a small army into battle in Mr Noobs vs Stickman. Select and move the noob troops to attack enemy positions while the stick figures fire back. Complete each confrontation by coordinating the advance and keeping the opposing army from taking your position.

pages.title: Zombies Are Coming
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Hold a defensive position in Zombies Are Coming. Tap to attack incoming undead and collect weapon pickups that improve the turret's firepower. Use explosives and freezing effects to handle large groups while keeping the endless horde away from the emplacement.

pages.title: Real Excavator Simulator
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Complete timed construction assignments in Real Excavator Simulator. Drive the provided machinery to marked areas and position it steadily to meet each mission's requirement. Use the movement keys and brake to handle the vehicles through the level's worksite.

pages.title: Hero Masters
pages.creator: Brosco Games
pages.description: Fight an alien invasion with changing powers in Hero Masters. Unlock superhero abilities as you progress, improve them, and alternate attacks to deal with different opponents. Choose among the available skins while continuing the campaign to eliminate the invaders.

pages.title: Mental Hospital Escape
pages.creator: Mad Buffer
pages.description: Investigate a locked institution in Mental Hospital Escape. Search the room for clues and useful discoveries that could explain how to leave. Connect the evidence and work through strange events as you solve the puzzles blocking the escape.

pages.title: Bhaag Santa Bhaag
pages.creator: Game Ashlar
pages.description: Help Santa gather presents in Bhaag Santa Bhaag. Move through platforms, jump over rocks and other obstacles, and collect gifts along the route. Complete each stage by bringing Santa safely to its finish with the required tasks done.

pages.title: Test Your Love
pages.creator: crazyschoolgames
pages.description: Try a fictional compatibility result in Test Your Love. Enter two names into the boxes and activate the test to see the number it produces. Results are randomly generated for entertainment, giving you another pairing to try without predicting a real relationship.

pages.title: Helicopter Mega Splash
pages.creator: Asylum Square Interactive GmbH
pages.description: Swing a heavy weapon from a helicopter in Helicopter Mega Splash. Move the aircraft so its wrecking ball smashes incoming enemies, collecting power-ups to strengthen the attack. Survive the advancing groups and return for the new challenge introduced each day.

pages.title: Rainbow Girls Christmas Outfits
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Create seasonal looks in Rainbow Girls Christmas Outfits. Browse the wardrobes for Skyler, Sunny, Ruby, and Violet, choosing clothing and accessories for the holiday celebration. Add makeover details to complete a coordinated Christmas appearance for each of the four friends.

pages.title: Hex Takeover
pages.creator: Game Worthy Studios Inc.
pages.description: Compete for territory in Hex Takeover. Select one of your hexagonal tiles and either clone it into a neighboring space or jump farther across the board. Use each turn to expand your color's area and take control of opposing pieces until you own the larger share.

pages.title: Halloween Hidden Objects
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Search a spooky scene in Halloween Hidden Objects. Compare the picture with the item list shown on the left and select the matching hidden objects. Complete the search before the countdown expires to earn the level's bonus points.

pages.title: Big NEON Tower VS Tiny Square
pages.creator: EO Interactive Ltd.
pages.description: Climb a large neon obstacle course in Big NEON Tower VS Tiny Square. Guide the small square through connected screen-sized sections, timing jumps around the hazards built into each area. Continue upward through the single tower as its platforming layouts become more demanding.

pages.title: Brave Knight of Epic Fantasy Adventure
pages.creator: mkhinteractive.com
pages.description: Fight through an old kingdom in Brave Knight of Epic Fantasy Adventure. Move the knight left or right through the dungeons while attacks happen automatically near enemies. Control the fighter's position to survive the groups of opponents along the arcade adventure.

pages.title: Easter Triple Mahjong
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Clear sets of festive tiles in Easter Triple Mahjong. Choose three identical pieces that each have at least two neighboring sides open, removing them from the arrangement. Complete the board before time expires, with faster clears producing a higher score.

pages.title: Julie Beauty Salon
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Give a visitor a new look in Julie Beauty Salon. Work through the available makeover choices, changing Julie's appearance with the salon's styling options. Compare the details you select and bring them together into a finished beauty look.

pages.title: MotorBike Racer 3D
pages.creator: Best Free Games
pages.description: Take a sports motorcycle onto racing routes in MotorBike Racer 3D. Start the engine and use the movement controls to guide the bike, activating nitro when extra speed is useful. Manage braking and steering through the next stretch of the ride.

pages.title: Casual Checkers
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Challenge the computer on a draughts board in Casual Checkers. Move pieces diagonally and plan captures that reduce the opposing side's options. The game uses English/American rules, including short-moving kings, as you work to take or block the opponent's remaining pieces.

pages.title: Drifty Master
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Drive a roadster through two hundred stages in Drifty Master. Steer around the changing track layouts and tackle higher difficulties as more routes open. Improve the current car or unlock another vehicle to prepare for later driving challenges.

pages.title: Lobster Jump Adventure
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Keep a crustacean bouncing safely in Lobster Jump Adventure. Jump onto jellyfish and collect red fish while staying clear of the screen's upper and lower edges. Use the directional controls to find another landing and remain in play for longer.

pages.title: Coloring Bunny Book
pages.creator: MG Studio
pages.description: Paint rabbit pictures in Coloring Bunny Book. Choose colors and apply them to the drawings, changing the appearance of the bunny and its surrounding details. Work through the scene in your preferred palette to complete the finished illustration.

pages.title: Blacksmith Clicker
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Make equipment for a monarch in Blacksmith Clicker. Click or tap to advance the forging activity and work toward unlocking more items. Continue producing weapons as the collection grows through the available blacksmithing projects.

pages.title: Summer Beach Parking
pages.creator: Bnagames
pages.description: Find a place for the car before a seaside outing in Summer Beach Parking. Drive through the parking lots and line up difficult spaces without damaging the vehicle. Adjust the approach around obstacles to finish each parking assignment before heading for the beach.

pages.title: Animals Valentine Coloring
pages.creator: MG Studio
pages.description: Color a collection of pets in Animals Valentine Coloring. Select shades and fill the illustrated animals, combining the palette into your preferred design. Complete the character and surrounding details before choosing another pet picture to decorate.

pages.title: Lovable Birds Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Reassemble six avian pictures in Lovable Birds Puzzle. Select a layout with sixteen, thirty-six, sixty-four, or one hundred pieces and reconnect the scattered image sections. Use the birds' outlines, feather colors, and background details to finish the chosen jigsaw.

pages.title: Hexa Time
pages.creator: DiHits
pages.description: Fit hexagonal shapes against a countdown in Hexa Time. Drag each piece onto the board and complete a line before the time limit expires. Keep planning space for the next blocks so another line can be finished as the puzzle continues.

pages.title: Nave X Racer
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Pilot a small spacecraft through an obstacle field in Nave X Racer. Choose one of three ship colors and steer around enemies while gathering gold bars. Keep the flight going to increase the points total and improve the recorded result.

pages.title: Dubai Drift 4x4 Simulator 3D
pages.creator: gamesfog
pages.description: Follow a timed driving route in Dubai Drift 4x4 Simulator 3D. Choose a jeep and reach checkpoints to keep the attempt going. Use the steering and braking controls to handle the road while pursuing the next marker before the remaining time runs out.

pages.title: Stack The Gifts Xmas
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Build a tower of wrapped presents in Stack The Gifts Xmas. Drag and drop each gift onto the growing pile, checking its position before releasing it. Work with the stack's physics to keep adding more boxes without losing the tower's balance.

pages.title: Perfect Roll Hit
pages.creator: Good Funny Game
pages.description: Guide a ball along winding elevated roads in Perfect Roll Hit. Move with the mouse to stay on the route and pass the obstacles ahead. Adjust the next turn early enough to keep the ball rolling through another section of the course.

pages.title: BTS Backstage
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Prepare a music group for its performance in BTS Backstage. Choose clothing and styling details for the band while their usual stylist is unavailable. Put together coordinated stage looks before the concert begins, comparing the available outfits for each performer.

pages.title: Happy Fun Glass Draw Lines
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames
pages.description: Fill an empty container in Happy Fun Glass Draw Lines. Sketch a support or channel that directs flowing water into the glass. Consider how gravity will carry the liquid along the drawn route, then adjust the design to complete the level.

pages.title: Truck Parking
pages.creator: Bnagames
pages.description: Maneuver a large vehicle through restricted layouts in Truck Parking. Drive around corners and obstacles, accounting for the truck's size when approaching the marked bay. Control the final alignment carefully to complete the parking task without meeting the surrounding barriers.

pages.title: Handless Millionaire
pages.creator: Bnagames
pages.description: Grab virtual cash from beneath a blade in Handless Millionaire. Watch the guillotine's cutting pattern and time each reach to collect money without losing the hand. Keep succeeding through the rounds as you pursue the game's million-dollar target.

pages.title: Pepperoni Gone Wild
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Escape a runaway meal in Pepperoni Gone Wild. Move downhill ahead of a giant rolling pizza, collecting coins and performing flips along the way. Spend the coins on skills or new appearances while keeping enough distance to avoid being crushed.

pages.title: Tattoo Salon Art Design
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Work on body-art pictures in Tattoo Salon Art Design. Guide the painting tool with the mouse to apply color to the design, filling its details a section at a time. Complete the selected artwork to finish the tattoo-styling activity.

pages.title: Train Driver Simulator 3D
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Operate a locomotive in Train Driver Simulator 3D. Use the mouse-based controls to manage the train and pay attention to other rail traffic. Signal approaching passenger and freight trains as you continue through the railroad simulation.

pages.title: Scrambled Word For Kids
pages.creator: Arcade Lemon
pages.description: Match vocabulary to pictures in Scrambled Word For Kids. Examine the images at the bottom of the screen and drag the correct words into the empty spaces above. Fill the required positions to complete the level and work through another group of illustrated words.

pages.title: Defend The Beach
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Defend a shoreline with typing in Defend The Beach. Enter words accurately to fire on the boats, ships, and aircraft arriving with the invasion. Keep pace with the growing enemy force as each completed word produces another attack on the approaching targets.

pages.title: Rise Up 2
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Protect a rising character in Rise Up 2. Move the guard to clear approaching obstacles before they reach the vulnerable figure behind it. Watch the next formation and push a route through its pieces so the upward journey can continue.

pages.title: Light It Up
pages.creator: F2K2.com
pages.description: Bring neon platforms to life in Light It Up. Jump, swing, and flip from one shape to another, lighting the surfaces the character reaches. Read the next gap and choose a landing that continues the glowing route through the level.

pages.title: Police Traffic
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Drive police vehicles along busy roads in Police Traffic. Steer around civilian cars, manage speed, and find openings through the moving traffic. Choose among eight police cars and four modes before returning for another highway-driving challenge.

pages.title: Spike and Ball
pages.creator: Dreamly Games
pages.description: Bounce between opposite walls in Spike and Ball. Move left and right and time jumps to reach a clear section of the next wall. Avoid the spikes around the landing areas so the ball can continue its back-and-forth run.

pages.title: Princess New Years Party
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Prepare three friends for a year-end celebration in Princess New Years Party. Choose party outfits for Barbie, Ladybug, and Ariel, comparing the clothing and accessories available for each character. Complete their looks before the group hosts its New Year's gathering.

pages.title: Hot Sexy Girl Darts
pages.creator: BestGames
pages.description: Aim for higher scores in Hot Sexy Girl Darts. Throw darts at the board and line up accurate hits around the target. Successful scoring also changes the accompanying character display, providing another progression element during the dart-throwing rounds.

pages.title: Monster High Nose Doctor
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Help two characters through a virtual examination in Monster High Nose Doctor. Inspect Laura and Frankie's nose problems and select the tools needed for each care step. Work through both appointments to finish the treatment activities presented by the game.

pages.title: Classic Solitaire Deluxe
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Move cards onto suit foundations in Classic Solitaire Deluxe. Rearrange the tableau and choose either one-card or three-card draws from the stock. Track results through the game's statistics and switch the layout's left or right alignment to suit your preferred arrangement.

pages.title: Hot Wheels
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Race a red car through busy roads in Hot Wheels. Drive in the oncoming lane and pass close to traffic to build the result, keeping clear of direct collisions. Balance those scoring opportunities against the space available around the next vehicle.

pages.title: Reversi Game
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Compete for board control in Reversi Game. Place a disc so opposing pieces are enclosed between it and another of your discs, flipping the captured line to your color. Look for moves that leave you with more controlled spaces as the board fills.

pages.title: Unicorn Kingdom
pages.creator: wopa interactive
pages.description: Explore three fantasy lands in Unicorn Kingdom. Guide a winged unicorn across the ground and into the air, collecting the magical gems scattered through each kingdom. Use galloping and flying movement to continue searching the different landscapes for their remaining treasures.

pages.title: Bottle Shoot
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Break airborne glass targets in Bottle Shoot. Aim and fire at the bottles as they appear, timing shots around their movement. Successive hits build combos and increase the score while another wave provides more bottles to destroy.

pages.title: Mommy BFFs Pregnant Check Up
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Accompany two friends to a virtual appointment in Mommy BFFs Pregnant Check Up. Use the available tools to measure their temperature and check their heartbeats. Finish the care routine with fruit and shakes after completing the pregnancy-themed examination steps.

pages.title: Doodle God Ultimate Edition
pages.creator: JoyBits
pages.description: Build a world through combinations in Doodle God Ultimate Edition. Begin with fire, earth, wind, and air, mixing elements to discover further creations. Watch new discoveries appear on the planet and use the developing collection to find another possible combination.

pages.title: pieai
pages.creator: Massive Games
pages.description: Grow by eating treats and rivals in pieai. Move through the arena gathering pies and smaller players while avoiding jam bombs dropped by flying drones. Keep the character out of the sticky attacks, or join team mode to cooperate with other players.

pages.title: Girl on Skates: Pizza Mania
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Run a delivery business in Girl on Skates: Pizza Mania. Take customers' orders and send pizzas to their destinations, responding to road obstacles during the skating sections. Buy upgrades with the earnings and assign deliveries to an employee when the counter needs your attention.

pages.title: Cactus Pinch
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Keep a colorful grid from filling in Cactus Pinch. Remove groups of at least two adjacent blocks of the same color to make space. Plan which clusters to clear so the next arrangement still offers useful matches and room to continue.

pages.title: Face Painting Central Park
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Give three princesses illustrated makeovers in Face Painting Central Park. Choose a face-paint pattern for each character and apply its colors, then consider clothing that suits the finished design. Complete the three looks for their visit to the park.

pages.title: HighSchool Fashion
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Create school-day outfits in HighSchool Fashion. Browse the available clothing for the characters and select pieces that work together as complete looks. Finish the accessories and styling details before sending the group back to school in their chosen outfits.
